purpose: Persistent editorial style for original mobile-game storytelling on TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

reference_analysis.inspection_method: Direct inspection of user-supplied MP4 metadata and sampled frames/contact sheets. The linked YouTube page itself remains fetch-throttled.
observed_facts: Portrait gaming story edit mixes Battlefield gameplay/cinematic shots with a visible creator facecam and brief reaction-meme cutaways.
It moves between first-person jet/air combat, parachute/ejection action, game UI/results and a brief real-world crowd/screen view, then returns to the creator reaction.
The reference uses close punch-ins and enlarged reaction crops; some portrait fills appear softened/blurred behind the focal image.
Vietnamese subtitles sit around the lower third with bold white text, dark outline/shadow and selective yellow word emphasis.
The edit mixes authentic game capture/cinematic material with creator reactions rather than relying on static cards or abstract vector scenes.
Visual cuts are frequent and tied to changes in action, reaction, or evidence; approximate sampled chapter ranges are recorded below.

timestamped_timeline.observation: Immediate creator/facecam reaction, followed by falling/parachute and explosion gameplay, then repeated close reaction and meme cutaways to establish the emotional premise.
Brief teal DICE title card acts as a chapter/identity beat.
First-person jet sequence: cockpit, aircraft pursuit, aiming reticle and kill/result UI. Shots stay tied to the narrated gameplay event.
Escalated first-person combat/explosion footage, result/UI inserts and a brief real-world screen/crowd shot provide payoff and scale.
The visual palette shifts to newer Battlefield soldier/cinematic footage, juxtaposing eras before returning to aircraft action.
The edit returns to the parachute/aircraft sequence and creator facecam; the creator's strong reaction/face-covering shot acts as the closing comic beat.

reference_analysis.audio_review: Audio stream metadata was inspected, but speech/music were not reliably transcribed or listened to in this analysis. Do not infer exact speech cadence, voice identity, or music/SFX mix from the sampled frames.
reference_analysis.reuse_boundary: The file is a visual style reference only. This analysis does not grant permission to reuse its footage, facecam, audio, captions, exact edit, or creator identity.
reference_analysis.note: Reference-specific claims above come from the supplied MP4's sampled frames. Timestamp ranges are approximate visual chapters, not a frame-by-frame edit decision list. The design translation below is Yuzhen-authored adaptation, not a copy of the reference.

observed_style_dna.story_delivery: A first-person gaming story supported by footage of the event and the creator's reactions.
caveats: Exact vocal delivery and audio balance are not yet verified by listening.
The specific Battlefield footage, DICE card, facecam, memes, captions, and audio are not reusable permissions.

editorial_requirements: Original Vietnamese script with a clear point of view, not a news readout or clip compilation.
Every factual, canon, or match claim is linked to a verified source.
Each source clip has a scene-specific editorial purpose mapped to narration.
Prefer game footage; verify game identity, source, timecode, and reuse basis before editing.
Never present illustrations or motion graphics as authentic gameplay.

proposed_editing_defaults.cut_rhythm: Adapt the reference's frequent, action-motivated cuts; keep every inserted shot relevant to the narrated claim and allow enough screen time to read the evidence.
image_treatment: use rights-cleared mobile-game footage as story evidence
vertical crop preserving the gameplay focal action
brief facecam or reaction inserts only when available and authorized
portrait blur fill only when needed to preserve the original frame
synchronized lower-third subtitles with white text, dark outline, and selective yellow emphasis
callouts only when they explain context
proposed_editing_defaults.sound: Keep Minh Quân as the sole narration voice. Voice leads; use only cleared music and selective SFX. Do not copy the reference soundtrack or voice.
proposed_editing_defaults.ending: Resolve the story question, then invite a specific audience response without manufacturing a cliffhanger.

media.platform_remix_scope: Use only within the platform feature and terms; never download for cross-platform reuse.
